ModMetaData.name: Unique Weapons Unbound
ModMetaData.author: Sam Hunt
ModMetaData.description:
Customize unique weapons at your workbenches. Colonists can add and remove weapon traits, turn an ordinary weapon into a unique one, and change a weapon's color, texture and name.
Customizing a weapon requires research and costs materials based on the weapon's crafting recipe and the trait being added. The costs and requirements can be adjusted in the mod options.
Requires Odyssey. Works with unique weapons and traits added by other mods.
